# Review, pass 1 — secret-history-211-213 (§§211–213)

Reviewer: strongest model, adversarial. Files read: conventions.md, runbook.md, run3/RUNBOOK.md (Reviewer), packet.md, units.json, known-forms.json, novel-forms.json, the model 01-06, and the published parts 093-099, 115-124, 191-193, 202-210 for house renderings. No modern translation opened or recalled. `units.json` edited in place by script; `t` untouched.

## Integrity checks (all clean)
- 40 units consume packet indices 0–236 exactly once, in order; every `t` equals the packet's romanized words joined by single spaces; every `words` list has one entry per word; `ln` 211/212/213 correct; `p: true` on U0 (§211), U10 (§212), U17 (§213) only.
- Every morph's last bracketed Ming gloss was compared with the packet gloss for that word: all agree (the only differences are Ming characters repeated on a stem and its suffix, e.g. 一同 on both töreküi and -lüġe, 也者︀ on both stem and -že, which is acceptable). No Ming gloss invented or misplaced.
- Quote marks: every Shiratori `"` is matched by a curly pair in `i`; the omitted opening mark at U37 is supplied in `i` only and the note says so (U37). Speech spans U1–U8, U11–U15, U18–U23, U25, U26, U27, U30–U35, U37–U38 close correctly.

## Changes (unit · field · severity · what was wrong · what was done)

1. U18 · i, n, morph · **major** · `i` read "Mönggetü-Kiyan's son, of the three Toquraud and five Tarqud", making the son a member of the three Toqura'ud and five Tarqud; the Mongol (γurban Toquraγ̇ud, tabun Tarqud, Möṅgetü-Kijan-u köġü) is a list, and the plural `ta` of U19 can only be taking the whole company up. The note admitted the grouping was a guess from nothing. The published §§115–120 shows exactly this company arriving together (three Toqura'un, five Tarqud, Möngetü-Kiyan's son with the Bishi'ud and Baja'ud). Also "Toquraud" broke the house γ̇ → ' rule and "Mönggetü" differs from the published "Möngetü". · `i` now "The three Toqura'ud, the five Tarqud, Möngetü-Kiyan's son,"; note rewritten (list in apposition, cites §§115–120, says it is a reading); morph glosses of Toquraγ̇ud and Möṅgetü-Kijan respelled.
2. U19 · i, n · moderate · follows from 1: `ta` is plural, and `i` "you formed" hid that it takes up the whole list; note said the plural subject was "Önggür and his people". · `i` "you all formed"; note now says the subject is the company of U18 with Önggür in apposition.
3. U1 · n · moderate · "Žarčiγ̇udai is the smith-father of Jelme": "smith" is not in the Mongol or the Ming (bellows only), "father" came from nowhere in the note. · Rewritten: Jelme's father on the evidence of §§93–99 (where he leads his son Jelme to Chinggis); kürege is the bellows.

## Findings considered and refused
- U3 `i` "he gave me" beside U2 "they came down": the subject of the chain is Jarchiudai, who leads his son (§§93–99) and comes with him; "they" for the arrival and "he" for the giver of the sable swaddling-cloth is defensible, and the note already says "he" is inferred.
- U2 note "Ming 行, 'to'" on the ablative Burqan-Qaldun-ača: the Ming does use 行 on ablatives (ečige-dēče 父行), and the note already says the form is followed.
- U11 `i` as a question: the note records that question versus statement is uncertain; the Ming 怎 supports the question and the choice is declared.
- U6 `i` "Born together at birth, grown together at growth": awkward but faithful to the Ming 生時 一同; a smoother version needs "we", which the note rightly avoids.
- U22 "you went on": jabuba-že with Ming 行了 is "went"; "went on" is a figure for sharing hardship and is flagged in the note. Left.
- U35 converbs morilažu jabužu rendered "mount, go about": the final verb is a plural imperative, and the house chain rule is kept by the note; left.
- U30 cooks "of the right side and the left": the note says the pairing is a reading and U31–U32 use the sides for diners; the Mongol is a bare list, left as declared.
- U37 "At the seating": saγ̇uri saγ̇urun "(at) sitting in the seat" is rendered loosely but the unit is flagged "very uncertain"; left.
- Morph baγ̇urči + -n "plural (Ming 每)" (U30): not in known-forms, but the Ming 每 is the plural mark and the glosser will see baγ̇určin as a token; left.
- `about`: "the rewards of 1206" matches §§204–207 and §§208–210 abouts; left.

## Counts
critical 0 · major 1 (item 1) · moderate 10 (items 2–11) · minor 12 (items 12–23); 23 changes in all.

## Remaining doubts (for pass 2 / the owner)
- U18–U19: the apposition reading of the list and "you all" rests on the plural `ta` and §§115–120, not on the Ming.
- U33: whether "ta qojar-i … tügeġeġeü" has "you two" as subject or object; -ġeü itself.
- U12–U14 (öröle, žiġür, žüġegsen(i)-jer(i)-jen): the "wing" figure and the heavy suffix chain are tentative as the notes say.
- U8: "nine times" — penalties incurred, not offences forgiven; matches the published parts but the Ming is thin.
- Glossary (pass 2): qari needs broadening to "tribe" (Ming 部落, known entry has 邦); köiten "cold" already broadened; tüblen, tüsürge, basaγ̇alažu, eteġed are new and uncertain.
